processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Synthesized from a 4-kg ingot; five Cu molds moved stepwise inside the furnace and were successively filled with melt.

processing_steps.reduction_ratio: 10×50×130 mm³ blocks hot rolled into 2±0.1 mm thick, ~500 mm long sheets

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: No subsequent aging (as-homogenized state; 0 h aging).

structures.overall_structure: Fully recrystallized single-phase austenitic (fcc) microstructure with average grain size ~20 µm and some retained Mn microsegregations; no cracks, pores, or macrosegregations in the final material.

phases_present.morphology: single austenite phase prevailing at room temperature

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: tensile specimens prepared from 2 mm thick sheet segments
measurement_conditions.other_conditions: All plotted values are averages of three measurements for every material state.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: room temperature; initial strain rate 10^-3 s^-1
characterization_methods.purpose: mechanical screening of yield strength, ultimate tensile strength and total elongation
characterization_methods.key_findings: as-homogenized 4 wt.% Al sample: YS ~350–450 MPa (Fig. 3a) and hardness ~200 HBW (Fig. 3d); tensile strength cluster ~460–600 MPa with elongation ~8–55% (Fig. 4).

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: rolling plane of samples ground to a thickness of 1 mm
cross-sections prepared in the plane perpendicular to the rolling direction
characterization_methods.key_findings: no cracks, pores, or macrosegregations in the final materials; fully recrystallized microstructure with grain size ~20 µm and some retained Mn microsegregations.

unmapped_findings: For the Fe-30Mn-1.2C-xAl set, the 4 wt.% Al and 6 wt.% Al alloys are only very weakly affected by the applied aging treatments in terms of their mechanical data, in contrast to Fe-30Mn-1.2C (weakening/embrittlement) and Fe-30Mn-1.2C-8Al (strengthening). [b0024]

With 4 wt.% Al (below 5 wt.%), a single austenite phase prevails at room temperature and the TWIP effect prevails as the deformation mechanism, classifying this as a single-phase austenitic TWIP (SIMPLEX) steel. [b0015, b0031]
The mechanical data for the intermediate 2–6 wt.% Al alloys fall between the respective values of the Al-free Fe-30Mn-1.2C alloy and the 8 wt.% Al alloy. [b0024]
